title: Emission-factor data file
description: Envelope for one source × edition of emission factors. Loaded by backend/app/factors_india/_registry.py. The validator there is hand-rolled (no jsonschema dependency), so this file is canonical documentation rather than enforced. Keep them in sync.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the factors apply to. Defaults to 'IN' when omitted (legacy CEA files).

source.description: Human-readable source name, e.g. 'CEA CO2 Baseline Database v20 (June 2025)'.

version.description: Stable version slug, e.g. 'CEA-2025-06'. Used as the version field on returned IndiaFactor.

vintage.description: ISO-date pair [from, to] giving the period the data applies to (typically an Indian financial year).

citation_url.description: Direct URL to the source document or landing page.

published_on.description: When the source publisher released this edition.

method.description: Calculation method per GHG Protocol Scope 2 Guidance.

grid_region.description: Indian electricity grid region (CEA convention) when regional_specificity == 'regional'.

state.description: Sub-national code: ISO 3166-2:IN state (e.g. 'MH', 'TN', 'GJ') or an Australian state/territory ('NSW', 'VIC', 'QLD', 'SA', 'WA', 'TAS', 'NT', 'ACT') when regional_specificity == 'state'.

value.description: Numeric emission factor in the unit above.

_placeholder.description: If true, the value has not been verified against the cited source. Loader returns IndiaFactor.is_placeholder=True so consumers can warn or refuse. A guard test xfail-marks runs until every placeholder is cleared.

_verify_against.description: Free-form note describing what the curator needs to consult to clear the placeholder.
